data.narrative:
Nascent Materials is a Seed-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector, having raised $2.3M to date. The valuation universe consists of 8 private peers and 1 public comparable (Lanzatech, ticker LNZA) operating in the same sector, though no private peers match both stage and valuation tier for robust peer benchmarking.

Given the limited peer set at identical stage and size, Stage-Progression methodology is the primary applicable approach. Using total raised ($2.3M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage yields an implied valuation of $5.75M. This method reflects observed market behavior for frontier-tech capital progression rather than sector-specific multiples, which remain underdetermined by comparable data.

The triangulated valuation range is $5M to $7M, with a median of $6M, supported by a single quantitative method. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of a 2.5x multiplier for this specific technical domain and the lack of narrow peer validation. A more robust range would require either comparable Seed-stage Climate & Energy financings at similar scale or early operational metrics (burn rate, customer traction, IP defensibility) not present in current data. Investors should treat this range as provisional pending accumulation of stronger stage- and sector-matched comps.
